legal_basis: Codigo Electoral Nacional Art. 53: national elections are held on the fourth Sunday of October before mandates end.
governance: Political factors are scenario assumptions. They may soften near-term demand through wait-and-see/speculation, but never overwrite actuals and never act as a permanent structural brake.

presidential.label: Presidential election cycle
presidential.interpretation: Mild pre-election postponement/speculation, strongest around October, followed by partial normalization.

legislative.label: Mid-term election cycle
legislative.interpretation: Smaller wait-and-see effect than a presidential election.
